afk install

  ✓ Check that this machine is a safe place for afk
  ○ Install the tools afk needs
  ○ Install the agent CLI
  ○ Sign in to the agent CLI
  ○ Let the agent run without permission prompts
  ○ Install the afk plugin
  ○ Sign in to GitHub
  ○ Set your git name and email
  ○ Choose where projects live
  ○ Set the web page password
  ○ Start the afk service
  ○ Check everything

Before anything changes

afk runs AI agents with their permission prompts turned off. They can run any
command, change any file and use every login on this machine without asking
first. That is why afk belongs on a machine set aside for it: a virtual machine,
or a computer you use for nothing else.

This is a virtual machine or a container, a good place for afk.

Press enter to go on, or ctrl+c to stop.
